call_sites: TransformerLayer._forward_mlp -> MLP.forward -> fc1 -> activation/gated path -> fc2
implementation_backend: composition of TP linear/GEMM and activation; optional Megatron fused bias-SwiGLU or TE SwiGLU op

forward.path: fc1 produces interleaved gate/up channels -> split/chunk -> activation and multiply -> fc2

backward.path: autograd for linear modules plus explicit custom autograd in fused_bias_swiglu.py or TE backward
backward.semantics: derivatives through SiLU, gate multiply, and both GEMMs

outputs: optional bias returned by linear module

distributed_semantics.tensor_parallel: intermediate dimension is partitioned; linear modules may overlap collectives

v100_feasibility: SUPPORTED_WITH_FALLBACK: FP16/BF16/FP32 and Megatron fused path are plausible; TE FP8 path is not assumed
candidate_optimization_boundary: C or B: fused bias+SwiGLU activation boundary, or a defined GEMM epilogue only if linear contract is preserved
open_questions: Bias and fusion flags in final model config
Whether TE activation op or Megatron fused function is selected
